title.zh: 英伟达推出DSXPOD ，缩短数据中心部署时间
title.en: 英伟达推出DSXPOD ，缩短数据中心部署时间

current_state.zh: At GTC Berlin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the DSX POD AI factory reference design, a pre-integrated modular container that Nvidia says can cut time-to-token deployment from six months to as little as 14 days, with global delivery starting in early 2027.
current_state.en: At GTC Berlin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the DSX POD AI factory reference design, a pre-integrated modular container that Nvidia says can cut time-to-token deployment from six months to as little as 14 days, with global delivery starting in early 2027.
